parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is used to isolate notify policy resources across different business spaces
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间 ID，用于隔离不同业务空间的通知策略资源
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求期望返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first page. For subsequent pages, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页凭证。首页不填，后续页传入上一页返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The policy name used for fuzzy filtering
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Valid values: createTime, updateTime, and name
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，支持 createTime、updateTime、name 等
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort results in descending order. Valid values:
- true: descending order.
- false: ascending order
parameters.help_zh: 是否倒序。true 为倒序，false 为正序
parameters.name: order_desc
